```yaml
name: ESLint Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run ESLint
      run: npm run eslint -- .
```

To add ESLint configuration with TypeScript support, you can create a `.eslintrc.json` file in the root of your repository with the following content:

```json
{
  "extends": [
    "eslint:recommended",
    "plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended"
  ],
  "parser": "@typescript-eslint/parser",
  "plugins": ["@typescript-eslint"],
  "rules": {
    // Add any custom rules here
  }
}
```

And add the following npm scripts to your `package.json`:

```json
"scripts": {
  "eslint": "eslint .",
  "eslint:fix": "eslint --fix ."
}
```
